subject.title: build(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: Should the macOS owners accept these three upstream Swift package updates after the exact-head `macos-swift` failure is resolved and native validation is shown?
rationale: The patch changes third-party runtime and updater dependencies, and the failed native lane does not establish whether the cause is an upstream compatibility issue, base drift, or CI-only failure.

options.title: Validate and merge
options.body: Refresh the branch, resolve the native check failure, and merge only after a macOS owner reviews the successful exact-head result.

options.title: Hold for targeted upstream review
options.body: Pause the grouped update if the native failure identifies an incompatibility that requires a narrower version selection or an application change.

options.title: Replace with a fresh Dependabot update
options.body: Close or supersede this branch only if a regenerated dependency PR against current main provides the same updates with clean native validation.

recommendation.title: Validate and merge
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, resolve the native check failure, and merge only after a macOS owner reviews the successful exact-head result.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline most directly routes this PR to tyler6204 for the macOS-area decision.
